info.name: F5 Load Balancer F5 BIG-IP Application Services 3 Extension (AS3) Config Monitors API
F5 Load Balancer List HTTP health monitors

items.docs: Retrieves all HTTP health monitors configured on the BIG-IP system. HTTP monitors verify availability by sending HTTP requests to pool members and evaluating the responses.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Create an HTTP health monitor

items.docs: Creates a new HTTP health monitor that sends HTTP requests to pool members to verify their availability and responsiveness.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List HTTPS health monitors

items.docs: Retrieves all HTTPS health monitors configured on the BIG-IP system. HTTPS monitors verify availability over TLS-encrypted connections.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List TCP health monitors

items.docs: Retrieves all TCP health monitors configured on the BIG-IP system. TCP monitors verify that pool members are accepting connections on the specified port.
